answer: Reputation-weighted task escrow. An agent's payout on each task is multiplied by a reputation score that decays unless the agent completes varied tasks over a sable horizon. New identities start near zero, so a sybil farm earns negligible yield while paying full compute. To reach parity with one established agent, an attacker must fund a mesa of identities through many unprofitable tasks, and the marginal cost per usable identity rises on a terrace as collateral requirements scale with farm size.
